# T-8: Namespace plugin config

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Apply plugin schema/defaults under plugin.config.<pluginId> and expose generic plugin-side agent execution support.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R8 acceptance is covered for schema merge, default merge, and no config file mutation.
- Top-level workflow config migration to plugin.config.workflow is covered by upgrade/config validation tests.
- Plugin-specific agent overrides are read by plugin code from plugin.config.<pluginId>.agent.<name> and passed to the generic API.
- Core does not interpret workflow-specific agent purpose names.

## Implementation Notes
Keep workflow.publish as a future removal target unless this task can remove it without migrating workflow implementation. The core API remains workflow-independent.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local config load tests and plugin command/hook API tests for generic agent override plumbing.
